- Each invocation links to the previous signature-derived seed, increments a per-key sequence and carries the public key. The chain rejects gaps, broken links and key changes. Verification checks each signature and recomputes its seed. A calibration package is declarative, integer-bounded data. It defines rarity weights, incubation cycles, affix counts and exclusions, stat budgets, and harmonic terms, amplitudes, phases, and symmetry. Hard gates reject authority-taking actions, wall-clock timing, undeclared odds, paid rolls, remote content, and engine costs. The package is validated but does not calibrate or adopt anything. `desdeValores` provides the current game baseline; troop validation checks rarity, affixes, stat bands, harmonic terms, amplitude, phase, and symmetry. Odds are represented exactly in basis points. Legacy troops without explicit edges use the package's rarity symmetry.

There is ONE map. "Solo debe existir 1 mapa, todo lo demás son pruebas" (·6524386655). It lives served at preceptoros.org with ALL the data of the system, and the map IS the bot colony: the real nodes are its bots, each with its building. Terminals, fixtures and contact sheets are TESTS, never the reality. Integration, not duplication: one state, many renders.
The manager supplies optional tones for measured skills in the current tab. It reuses the existing radio and synthesis modules, stores no events, and makes no network requests.

`public/game/ui-arena-comun.js:1-8` defines the shared arena labels and rendering entry point. Language-specific arena labels are loaded from language data; shared labels remain in the game surface. `public/game/ui-arena.js:1-27,60-108` separates map selection from battle, presents one primary action, and omits absent upgrade data rather than serializing an undefined value. Its replay path at `:132-170` reuses the established battle replay when available and keeps the existing scene fallback. The game roster and local record are read from their established sources at `:253-265`.

A genome is a bounded set of integer parameters grouped by declared domains. Unknown parameters, fractional values, out-of-range values, and forbidden authority, persistence, network, identity, or physical-engine controls are rejected. Its canonical parameter hash is independent of key order. The local system may propose changes; adoption, activation, and persistence remain human-authorized. The module is pure and performs no DOM, network, clock, or random operations.

MODELO FANTASMA (PLAN §3): se ataca una DEFENSA FIRMADA (tu Army de cara a los demas), no a la persona conectada. Asi se juega entre husos horarios y con la bateria baja. 1. El defensor publica `defensa` en su tablon: `{tc, semilla}` de cada tropa, el `pack_sha` de los valores con los que juega y lo que declara `en_juego`. 2. En una sesion de duelo (`modo: 'duelo'`, los dos pares) el atacante manda su `asalto`, que nombra la huella de esa defensa; los dos se comprometen y revelan (`sobres.js`). 3. `resuelve` saca la semilla del commit-reveal y juega `combate`: rondas ENTERAS, sin decimales ni reloj. Cualquiera lo vuelve a jugar y sale igual: el resultado no se cree, se comprueba.

EL PRECIO, Y SE DICE ANTES: una clave que nadie puede leer tampoco se puede exportar ni copiar a otro aparato. Si borras los datos del sitio, esa identidad se pierde y no hay «recuperar contrasena» porque no hay contrasena. Es el mismo trato de una llave fisica, y quien firma tiene derecho a saberlo antes de firmar.

ESTADO: PROVISIONAL. Todo numero de aqui es provisional y se dice en pantalla (Soberano, 2026-09-27: «no te preocupes por recursos, habilidades ni niveles; haz la estructura; los valores y los LoRAs los adherimos despues»). La logica (`gacha.js`, `core.js`) no lleva ni una cifra de equilibrio: las lee de aqui. Cambiar el juego es cambiar ESTE fichero, y el dia que haya valores de verdad se cambia `estado` y se versiona.

EL ROMBO ES LA LEY. Cada celda del mundo es un diamante 2:1 (ancho W, alto H = W/2): (col, fila) -> pantalla x = (col - fila) * W/2 , y = (col + fila) * H/2 y TODO objeto se ancla al CENTRO de su rombo, nunca a una esquina.
